Publish derived values

Source: R/publish-values.R
soil_publish_values.Rd

Publishes the values computed by an external model in an open run (soil_run_open()), against existing canonical targets (feature, profile, component or horizon ids). The hub stores, validates and serves them; it runs no model.

Usage

soil_publish_values(
  soil = soil_session(),
  run_id,
  values,
  idempotency_key,
  validate = TRUE,
  transport = c("auto", "sync", "ndjson"),
  wait = TRUE,
  timeout = 3600,
  poll = 5,
  progress = interactive()
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

run_id

The id of an open run. API path parameter {run_id} of POST /publications/{run_id}/values, /validate and /jobs (for soil_publish_health(): /soil-health and /soil-health/jobs).

values

A data frame (list columns for nested fields) or a list of records with variable_code, target_level, target_id (UUID), value (typed as the variable: number, text, logical, or a list for json), value_status ("published", the default, needs a value; "insufficient_data" and "not_applicable" none), release_id, quality_code, valid_time_start, valid_time_end, depth_top_cm, depth_bottom_cm (optional) and lineage: a list with one or more of observations, values, releases, assets, each a list of list(id =, role =, transformation =) (or a data frame), at least one item in all. NA fields are left out. API field values; with the NDJSON transport, the lines of the file sent as API form field file.

idempotency_key

Key of this publication (at most 200 characters), stable for one content. API field idempotency_key of a synchronous publication; API query parameter idempotency_key of an NDJSON upload.

validate

Validate on the server before publishing. Client-side: decides whether POST /publications/{run_id}/validate is called first; not sent to the API.

transport

"auto" (synchronous up to 10,000 records, else NDJSON), "sync" or "ndjson". Client-side: not sent to the API.

wait

For a job: wait for it to end (see soil_job_wait()). Client-side: not sent to the API.

timeout, poll

Seconds to wait for a job, and between two polls. Client-side: not sent to the API.

progress

Print the progress of the job. Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

A soil_publication list: transport, run_id, status, record_count (records sent), received_count, published_count, publication_id (the receipt), idempotent_replay, validation (the server validation, or NULL), and for a job job_id, job (the last soil_job), checksum_sha256, byte_size. With wait = FALSE the job is returned as submitted (status queued): follow it with soil_job_wait(). A job that fails is a soilhub_job_error whose errors holds the rejected rows reported by the job.

Details

Steps:

  1. local checks of every record (required fields, target level and id, value_status and value, lineage, depth and time intervals): problems are a soilhub_argument_error whose errors lists them by record;

  2. with validate = TRUE, server validation without writing (POST /publications/{run_id}/validate: run open, variables declared by the version, targets and lineage existing, typed values, duplicates); an invalid batch is a soilhub_validation_error with the API's errors (row is 0-based, record the 1-based record);

  3. publication: synchronous (POST /publications/{run_id}/values) up to 10,000 records, else (transport = "ndjson", or "auto" above 10,000) an NDJSON file with its SHA-256 checksum uploaded as a job (POST /publications/{run_id}/jobs). Before an upload with validate = TRUE the client checks that every variable_code is registered (soil_variables()); the job validates the whole file on the server before publishing anything.

The upload is never repeated automatically and has no total timeout (only the connection timeout). Publication is idempotent: the same idempotency_key with the same content returns the first receipt (idempotent_replay = TRUE) or the job already submitted, so after a transport failure call the function again with the same key and the same values. The same key with different content is a soilhub_conflict_error (HTTP 409): use a new key.

The receipt is reconciled with the records sent: a published_count different from their number is a soilhub_reconciliation_warning; do not complete the run until it is understood.

Rights: soil:publish. Capabilities: publish_generic_values (synchronous), generic_bulk_publication (job).

See also

Other writing: soil_product(), soil_product_version(), soil_publish_health(), soil_publish_source(), soil_register_variable(), soil_run_open(), soil_source_validate()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
values <- data.frame(
  variable_code = "soil_health_physical_score", target_level = "horizon",
  target_id = horizon_ids, value = scores
)
values$lineage <- lapply(observation_ids, function(id) {
  list(observations = list(list(id = id, role = "bulk_density")))
})
receipt <- soil_publish_values(soil, run$run_id, values, "pub-india-2026-10-a")
receipt$published_count
} # }
